tasks.title: Write failing tests: compactToParallelFile failure/safety path
tasks.description: Extend src/capture/vcc-bridge.test.ts: mock the module's spawnSync boundary to force a non-zero exit, and separately to throw, from compactToParallelFile; spy on fs.renameSync and assert across both the success test (task-005) and these forced-failure runs that renameSync is never called with any argument whose path.resolve() equals jsonlPath; assert on forced failure that the source file is byte-identical to a pre-read buffer, that no `${jsonlPath}.vcc-shrunk.jsonl` file exists afterward, and that the function returns { ok: false, error, path: undefined }. This is the regression test proving the ADR-015 'structurally incapable of targeting jsonlPath' hard constraint. Tests must fail against current vcc-bridge.ts, which has no guard or failure handling yet.

tasks.title: Implement end-of-reflect() parallel-compact trigger
tasks.description: In src/capture/reflector.ts export const VCC_PARALLEL_COMPACT_BYTES = 200_000 and define a local VCC_PARALLEL_COMPACT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000. Append the trigger as the final block of reflect() — after memory persistence, the redaction-logging block, and advanceCursor, and strictly after the disabled compactFileInPlace block (lines 274-288), which must remain byte-for-byte untouched (no reordering, no comment edits). Wrap the trigger in its own try/catch that only console.error's on failure and never throws or changes reflect()'s return value. Logic: skip if rawLines is empty, or opts.transcript_path is falsy, or byte length <= VCC_PARALLEL_COMPACT_BYTES; otherwise call compactToParallelFile(opts.transcript_path, { timeoutMs: VCC_PARALLEL_COMPACT_TIMEOUT_MS }); on { ok: true, path } run UPDATE sessions SET vcc_shrunk_path = ? WHERE session_id = ?; on failure, console.error only, no UPDATE (leave any prior value untouched, do not reset to NULL). Make task-009's tests pass, confirm the full existing reflector.test.ts suite stays green, then run the full npm test suite to confirm zero regressions repo-wide.
